verdict.rationale: smolagents is a code-first Python framework: agents are built, run, customized, replayed, and shared entirely via its Python API (agent.replay(), step callbacks, push_to_hub/from_hub, managed_agents), with CLI utilities (smolagent, webagent) as thin wrappers rather than a separate GUI with exclusive features. There is no evidence of a GUI offering functionality inaccessible via the API, so API/code parity is inherent to the product's design. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation contrasting a GUI feature set against API capabilities, and no independent hands-on confirmation that CLI tools expose 100% of library functionality.
